continuity: Namho is the Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent operating under the cover of the Poison Flower Pavilion in Nanman; he confirms his identity through Thousand-Faced Fox’s code exchange.
Namho has spent more than fifty years surveying Nanman’s terrain and tribal locations and gives the Fire Dragon Pavilion his wooden map.
Namho agrees to guide the Fire Dragon Pavilion wherever its Nanman mission requires and leaves his longtime residence with them.
Namho has received the Pavilion Master’s warning about the rift through a messenger eagle and accepts that Dark Heaven is likely targeting Nanman.
The Contact with a Hidden Shadow Pavilion Agent mission and Seeds Planted in Nanman Quest are complete, and a new linked Quest has appeared.
The identity of the woman associated with the Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau group and the party responsible for poisoning that group remain unresolved.
The Fire Dragon Pavilion’s dangers and objectives beyond the Hidden Shadow Pavilion contact, including the Nanman Beast Palace mission, remain unresolved.
plot: The Fire Dragon Pavilion confirms that the Poison Flower Pavilion owner is Namho, a non-Han Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent. To conceal their meeting, Namho stages a violent expulsion that destroys the inn, then reunites with the group at a lakeside rendezvous. He gives them a wooden map documenting Nanman’s terrain and tribes over more than fifty years, confirms that he has received warnings about the rift, and agrees to guide them toward their destination. The contact mission and Seeds Planted in Nanman Quest are completed, a new linked Quest is generated, and Namho leaves his home with the group because he believes Dark Heaven will soon bring catastrophe to Nanman.
translation_decisions: Render 남호 as Namho and 챠오 어르신 as Elder Chao, distinguishing the agent’s codename from his local identity and title.
Continue rendering 남만 as Nanman, 암천 as Dark Heaven, 전서응 as messenger eagle, and 반 시진 as half a shichen.
Render 남만에 심은 씨앗 as Seeds Planted in Nanman and 은영각 요원과 접선 as Contact with a Hidden Shadow Pavilion Agent.

active_continuity: The Fire Dragon Pavilion has completed contact with Namho, a Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent operating under the cover of the Poison Flower Pavilion in Nanman.
Namho spent more than fifty years mapping Nanman’s terrain and tribal locations and has given the Fire Dragon Pavilion his wooden map.
Namho has left his residence and agreed to guide the Fire Dragon Pavilion toward its Nanman destination.
Namho received the Pavilion Master’s warning about the rift through a messenger eagle.
Namho and Jin Taekyung believe Dark Heaven is targeting Nanman and that a major catastrophe is imminent.

open_questions: What is the objective of the newly generated linked Quest?
Was the woman in the Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau group the Southern Heaven Demon Empress?
Who poisoned and killed the Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau group, and why?
What catastrophe will Dark Heaven cause in Nanman?
What dangers await the Fire Dragon Pavilion at the Nanman Beast Palace?

profile_creations.personality: Duty-bound, pragmatic, observant, and willing to use theatrical violence and crude insults to protect an intelligence operation.
profile_creations.relationships: Namho is a Hidden Shadow Pavilion contact for Jin Taekyung and the Fire Dragon Pavilion, receives intelligence from the Pavilion Master, and knows the code used by the Thousand-Faced Fox.
profile_creations.role: Namho is a non-Han Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent who operated for decades under the cover of the Poison Flower Pavilion in Nanman and now serves as the Fire Dragon Pavilion’s guide.
profile_creations.voice: Measured and serious in private, but loudly abusive and convincing when maintaining his local cover.
